title: China-to-Rwanda Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Rwanda Standards Board (RSB) declares Rwanda Standards that adopt the IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn/garden motor-operated electric tools. Power tools are caught by RSB mandatory product control through Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC); the tool, and its charger or external power supply for cordless models, must meet the applicable RS/IEC 62841 and charger safety requirements. Rwanda mains supply is 230 V, 50 Hz, so 50 Hz Chinese designs are frequency-compatible but the nominal voltage point differs from China 220 V single-phase and 380 V three-phase.
target_standards: RS that adopts IEC 62841 series (general and particular requirements for motor-operated electric tools)
RSB Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) and Certificate of Conformity requirement
RS charger or power-supply safety standard where in scope
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly use GB/T 3883 series for tool safety, with CCC where applicable and separate charger evidence. These reports can support the technical review but must be mapped to the declared RS/IEC 62841 edition and submitted through the RSB PVoC route rather than treated as automatic Rwanda acceptance.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The gap is procedural and editioning, not redesign: GB/T 3883 evidence must be cross-walked to the RS/IEC 62841 edition that RSB declares, the charger or external power supply assessed separately, and the whole package routed through PVoC for a Certificate of Conformity rather than relying on the China domestic certificate alone.

target.en: Mandatory in practice: RSB PVoC and Certificate of Conformity are required before import, with conformity to the RS that adopts IEC 62841 and an S-Mark where RSB requires it. The underlying RS/IEC test standards are the technical route used to demonstrate conformity within that mandatory scheme.
target.zh: 实务强制：进口前需取得 RSB PVoC 和符合性证书，并符合采用 IEC 62841 的 RS，RSB 要求时加贴 S 标志。底层 RS/IEC 测试标准是在该强制方案内证明符合性的技术路径。
target.zht: 實務強制：進口前需取得 RSB PVoC 和符合性證書，並符合採用 IEC 62841 的 RS，RSB 要求時加貼 S 標誌。底層 RS/IEC 測試標準是在該強制方案內證明符合性的技術路徑。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses GB/T 3883 series and charger-specific standards, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及充电器专项标准，适用时附 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及充電器專項標準，適用時附 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until GB/T 3883 evidence is mapped to the RSB-declared RS/IEC 62841 edition, the charger or external supply is assessed separately, and a Certificate of Conformity is obtained through RSB PVoC with an S-Mark where required.

rows.target_requirement: Rwanda Standards that adopt the IEC/CISPR electromagnetic compatibility series cover emission and immunity for electric tools. Within the RSB PVoC scheme, EMC evidence to the relevant RS/CISPR 14 family (or the EMC clauses referenced by the adopted tool standard) is expected alongside electrical safety. For cordless tools with intentional radio transmitters, EMC sits beside, and does not replace, RURA radio-equipment requirements.
target_standards: RS that adopts CISPR 14-1 and CISPR 14-2 (EMC for household appliances and electric tools)
RSB Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) for in-scope products
RURA radio-equipment authorisation for intentional transmitters (separate from EMC)
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly carry GB/T 3883 safety plus GB EMC reports aligned to the CISPR 14 series. The CISPR-based test content is broadly comparable, but the report must be mapped to the RS edition RSB declares and submitted under PVoC, not relied on as a standalone China certificate.
china_standards: GB EMC standards aligned to the CISPR 14 series
rows.gap: Because both China and Rwanda lean on the CISPR 14 family, the EMC test substance is usually close. The gap is documentary: aligning the EMC report to the RSB-declared RS edition, packaging it within PVoC, and separately handling any RURA radio obligation for transmitter-equipped cordless tools.

target.en: Mandatory in practice within the RSB PVoC scheme for in-scope tools: EMC conformity to the adopted RS/CISPR 14 family. RURA authorisation is a separate mandatory obligation for intentional radio transmitters.
target.zh: 在 RSB PVoC 方案内对适用工具实务强制：符合所采用 RS/CISPR 14 系列的 EMC。RURA 许可对主动无线电发射器为单独的强制义务。
target.zht: 在 RSB PVoC 方案內對適用工具實務強制：符合所採用 RS/CISPR 14 系列的 EMC。RURA 許可對主動無線電發射器為單獨的強制義務。

cn.en: China EMC evidence (GB aligned to CISPR 14) does not automatically satisfy RSB PVoC submission requirements.
cn.zh: 中国 EMC 证据（与 CISPR 14 对齐的 GB）不会自动满足 RSB PVoC 提交要求。
cn.zht: 中國 EMC 證據（與 CISPR 14 對齊的 GB）不會自動滿足 RSB PVoC 提交要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Likely close on test substance but not Rwanda-ready until the CISPR 14-based EMC report is mapped to the RSB-declared RS edition, submitted under PVoC, and any RURA radio obligation for cordless transmitters is handled separately.

rows.requirement: Market Access Under RSB PVoC and S-Mark
rows.target_requirement: Rwanda market access for regulated electric tools runs through the Rwanda Standards Board (RSB): Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) in the country of export, a Certificate of Conformity issued before shipment, and an S-Mark of quality where RSB requires it. Rwanda is landlocked, so goods are typically cleared and trans-shipped via the ports of Mombasa (Kenya) or Dar es Salaam (Tanzania) before inland transit, which makes a pre-shipment Certificate of Conformity important to avoid border holds.
target_standards: RSB Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) programme
RSB Certificate of Conformity required before shipment
RSB S-Mark (mark of quality) where required
RS national standards adopting the relevant IEC tool series
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic market access relies on GB/T 3883 conformity and CCC where applicable. CCC governs entry to the China market and does not by itself grant Rwanda market access, which is controlled by the RSB PVoC and Certificate of Conformity route.
china_standards: CCC where applicable (China market access only)
rows.gap: The market-access gap is the conformity-assessment pathway, not the product design: a CCC certificate and GB/T 3883 report do not substitute for an RSB Certificate of Conformity. Exporters must engage a PVoC scheme before shipment, plan for trans-shipment via Mombasa or Dar es Salaam, and apply the S-Mark where RSB requires it.

target.en: Mandatory: RSB PVoC and a Certificate of Conformity before shipment for regulated products, plus the S-Mark where RSB requires it. The underlying RS/IEC standards are the technical basis used inside this mandatory scheme.
target.zh: 强制：受管制产品出货前须取得 RSB PVoC 和符合性证书，并在 RSB 要求时加贴 S 标志。底层 RS/IEC 标准是该强制方案内使用的技术依据。
target.zht: 強制：受管制產品出貨前須取得 RSB PVoC 和符合性證書，並在 RSB 要求時加貼 S 標誌。底層 RS/IEC 標準是該強制方案內使用的技術依據。

cn.en: CCC and GB/T 3883 govern China domestic market access only and do not grant Rwanda entry.
cn.zh: CCC 和 GB/T 3883 仅管控中国国内市场准入，不授予卢旺达准入。
cn.zht: CCC 和 GB/T 3883 僅管控中國國內市場准入，不授予盧旺達准入。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Rwanda-ready until the exporter completes RSB PVoC, holds a pre-shipment Certificate of Conformity, applies the S-Mark where required, and plans trans-shipment via Mombasa or Dar es Salaam; a China CCC certificate alone is insufficient for entry.

rows.requirement: Noise: No EU-Style Outdoor Product Marking
rows.target_requirement: Rwanda does not operate an equivalent of EU Directive 2000/14/EC, so there is no separate guaranteed-sound-power-level marking obligation imposed on outdoor power tools as a product-marking regime at the point of import. Where noise is addressed, it is through the noise clauses inside the adopted RS/IEC 62841 safety standards (declared noise and vibration emission values in the instructions) and through general occupational-health and environmental frameworks that apply to workplaces and the environment rather than to the product label. Exporters should not assume a Rwanda outdoor-noise product mark exists, and should not fabricate one; the honest position is that the obligation is mainly declared-value and workplace-based, not a CE-style noise mark.
target_standards: Noise and vibration declaration clauses within the adopted RS/IEC 62841 series (instruction-manual declared values)
Rwanda general occupational-safety and environmental framework (workplace and environmental noise, not product marking)
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and typically includes declared noise and vibration values in line with the IEC tool standard. China also has no obligation matching the EU outdoor-noise product mark, so on this point the two regimes are comparable: declared values rather than a separate noise-marking certificate.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series (declared noise and vibration values)
China workplace and environmental noise framework where applicable
rows.gap: There is little product-marking gap here: neither China nor Rwanda imposes an EU-style outdoor-noise product mark. The realistic action is to keep the declared noise and vibration values consistent in the RS/IEC 62841 instruction set and to treat workplace and environmental noise as a site-and-employer matter, not a product-import barrier. Do not invent a Rwanda noise certificate that does not exist.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style outdoor-noise product mark in Rwanda. Declared noise and vibration values are required as part of the adopted RS/IEC 62841 documentation; workplace and environmental noise sits under general frameworks, not product import control.
target.zh: 卢旺达无强制的欧盟式户外噪声产品标志。声明的噪声和振动值作为所采用 RS/IEC 62841 文件的一部分而要求；工作场所和环境噪声归一般框架，而非产品进口管控。
target.zht: 盧旺達無強制的歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標誌。聲明的噪聲和振動值作為所採用 RS/IEC 62841 文件的一部分而要求；工作場所和環境噪聲歸一般框架，而非產品進口管控。

cn.en: China likewise has no EU-style outdoor-noise product mark; declared values per the IEC tool standard are the norm.
cn.zh: 中国同样无欧盟式户外噪声产品标志；按 IEC 工具标准给出声明值为常规。
cn.zht: 中國同樣無歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標誌；按 IEC 工具標準給出聲明值為常規。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No specific Rwanda outdoor-noise product mark applies; keep RS/IEC 62841 declared noise and vibration values accurate and treat workplace and environmental noise under general frameworks. Do not claim or fabricate a Rwanda noise-marking certificate.

rows.target_requirement: Rwanda does not operate an exact equivalent of the EU RoHS directive as a standalone product-marking regime, but restricted-substance and material-safety expectations reach power tools through adopted RS standards that align to IEC material and safety provisions, environmental management under the Rwanda Environment Management Authority framework, and any chemical and e-waste controls. Within RSB PVoC, a credible material-safety and restricted-substance position (declarations, supplier evidence) supports the conformity file even where no single RoHS-style mark is issued.
target_standards: Adopted RS standards aligned to IEC material and safety provisions
Rwanda environmental management and e-waste framework (REMA) where applicable
RSB PVoC conformity file (material-safety declarations and supplier evidence)
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly carry GB/T 3883 safety plus China RoHS marking and material declarations. This evidence is useful supporting material, but Rwanda acceptance is through the RSB PVoC conformity file rather than recognition of the China RoHS mark itself.
china_standards: China RoHS marking and material declarations where applicable
rows.gap: The gap is documentary and honest scoping: there is no Rwanda RoHS mark to obtain, so exporters should carry material-safety and restricted-substance declarations into the RSB PVoC file and align to adopted RS and environmental and e-waste rules, rather than claiming a Rwanda RoHS certificate that does not exist.

target.en: No standalone Rwanda RoHS-style product mark; restricted-substance and material-safety expectations are addressed within the RSB PVoC conformity file and applicable environmental and e-waste frameworks.
target.zh: 无独立的卢旺达 RoHS 式产品标志；限用物质和材料安全要求在 RSB PVoC 符合性文件及适用的环境与电子废弃物框架内处理。
target.zht: 無獨立的盧旺達 RoHS 式產品標誌；限用物質和材料安全要求在 RSB PVoC 符合性文件及適用的環境與電子廢棄物框架內處理。

cn.en: China RoHS and GB/T 3883 evidence supports the file but does not by itself satisfy the Rwanda PVoC submission.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 和 GB/T 3883 证据支持文件，但本身不满足卢旺达 PVoC 提交。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 和 GB/T 3883 證據支援文件，但本身不滿足盧旺達 PVoC 提交。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No specific Rwanda RoHS mark applies; carry material-safety and restricted-substance declarations into the RSB PVoC file and align to adopted RS and e-waste rules. Do not claim a Rwanda RoHS certificate.

rows.requirement: Cordless Battery and RURA Radio Authorisation
rows.target_requirement: Rwanda does not operate the EU Battery Regulation, so there is no battery-passport or removability product-marking regime at import; lithium battery packs are addressed mainly as a safety and transport matter (RS/IEC safety clauses for the battery and charger, and UN lithium-battery transport rules for shipment via Mombasa or Dar es Salaam). The distinct Rwanda obligation for cordless tools is RURA: cordless tools that contain an intentional radio transmitter (for example wireless connectivity) require Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority type approval or authorisation of the radio equipment, separate from the RSB safety conformity.
target_standards: RS/IEC safety clauses for the battery and charger within the adopted tool standard
UN lithium-battery transport rules (UN 38.3) for shipment via Mombasa or Dar es Salaam
RURA type approval or authorisation for cordless tools with intentional radio transmitters
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files usually treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, plus separate lithium-battery safety and transport evidence, and SRRC radio type approval for transmitter modules in the China market. SRRC approval governs China only; Rwanda radio use is controlled by RURA.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series (battery pack tested with the tool)
China lithium-battery safety and transport evidence (UN 38.3)
SRRC radio type approval for transmitter modules (China market only)
rows.gap: Two honest distinctions: (1) there is no Rwanda EU-style battery-passport or removability product mark, so the battery obligation is safety-and-transport, not a separate battery CE mark; (2) SRRC radio approval does not carry into Rwanda, so any cordless tool with a wireless transmitter needs separate RURA type approval. A China-tested cordless tool can still be blocked at the radio-authorisation step even if its battery safety is sound.

target.en: Battery: no standalone Rwanda battery product mark; safety addressed via RS/IEC clauses and UN 38.3 transport rules. Radio: mandatory RURA type approval or authorisation for cordless tools that contain an intentional radio transmitter.
target.zh: 电池：无独立的卢旺达电池产品标志；安全通过 RS/IEC 条款和 UN 38.3 运输规则处理。无线电：含主动无线电发射器的无绳工具须取得 RURA 强制型号核准或许可。
target.zht: 電池：無獨立的盧旺達電池產品標誌；安全透過 RS/IEC 條款和 UN 38.3 運輸規則處理。無線電：含主動無線電發射器的無繩工具須取得 RURA 強制型號核准或許可。

cn.en: China battery and SRRC radio evidence governs the China market and does not satisfy Rwanda RURA radio authorisation.
cn.zh: 中国电池和 SRRC 无线电证据管控中国市场，不满足卢旺达 RURA 无线电许可。
cn.zht: 中國電池和 SRRC 無線電證據管控中國市場，不滿足盧旺達 RURA 無線電許可。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For cordless tools, address the battery via RS/IEC safety clauses and UN 38.3 transport rather than an EU-style battery mark, and obtain separate RURA radio type approval where a wireless transmitter is present; China SRRC approval does not transfer to Rwanda.
